about: WestBond Enterprises Corporation, together with its subsidiary WestBond Industries Inc., manufactures and sells disposable paper products for medical, hygienic, and food services industries in Canada and the United States. The company offers high sheet count tissues, household bathroom tissues, bathroom tissue jumbo rolls, coreless tissues, center feed towels, and airlaid center feed towels; hospitality and tabletop paper products comprising airlaid napkins, guest towels, airlaid kitchen roll towels, and disposable bar towels; and clinical products, including examination table papers, chiropractic rolls, waterproof sheets, pillowcases, examination drapes and gowns, and ultrasound towels and wipers. It also provides long-term care products, including air laid patient wipes and waterproof underlays; disinfectant wipes and sprays; and airlaid rolls for converters. WestBond Enterprises Corporation was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Delta, Canada.
